title: Iran's parliament speaker says U.S. will be "nostalgic" for $4 gas as oil prices fuel inflation
summary: Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf said Americans would soon be "nostalgic for $4-$5 gas" after President Trump announced a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday. Taurean Small reports on the pain at the pump currently being felt across the United States.
